name: Vignesh J
title: Software Engineer · Full-Stack & Systems
summary: Software Engineer with 3 years of professional experience designing, building, and scaling modern full-stack web applications and distributed internal platforms. Proven track record architecting high-throughput systems with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, alongside backend ecosystems in PHP/Laravel, MySQL, and Redis. Built mission-critical tools used daily by 400+ active users across 7 enterprise teams. Experienced in zero-downtime database migrations, API latency reduction (40%+), asynchronous message queues, containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), and AI agent workflows (OpenAI, MCP). Focused on engineering maintainable, observable, and resilient software that accelerates business growth.

bullets: Unified Multi-Team Platform: Solved operational fragmentation and manual spreadsheet tracking across 7 departments (CX, Sales, Product, Visa, Finance) by architecting a high-throughput full-stack platform (React, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, PostgreSQL, Redis) serving 400+ daily active users as the single source of truth.

Autonomous AI Pipeline Automation: Eliminated manual post-call logging overhead by engineering an event-driven AI workflow using OpenAI APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool wiring — delivering automated call summarization, sentiment classification, and zero-touch CRM pipeline transitions.

High-Throughput API & Database Optimization: Solved peak sales database contention and slow endpoints by implementing multi-tier Redis caching, connection pooling (PgBouncer), and SQL index tuning — slashing average API response latency by 40%+ and reducing database CPU load by 50%.

Automated Refund & Finance Pipelines: Solved 3–5 day manual customer refund delays by engineering automated CX and Finance approval pipelines with immutable audit logs — cutting refund turnaround time to under 24 hours.

Zero-Downtime Microservices Migration: Solved monolithic scaling bottlenecks by decoupling mission-critical services and executing zero-downtime database and schema migrations with zero operational disruption.

Mission-Critical Test Automation: Hardened payment, dynamic pricing, and visa allocation modules against edge-case failures by implementing end-to-end automated testing suites (Pest, Jest, Playwright).

Real-Time Telemetry Portals: Solved real-time vehicle and asset tracking visibility challenges by building responsive portals and interactive telemetry dashboards using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL with sub-second updates.

Database Query & Throughput Tuning: Solved slow reporting queries over high-frequency time-series tracking data by restructuring indexes and optimizing serialization, improving overall backend API throughput by 30%.

Enterprise Security & RBAC Hardening: Solved access vulnerabilities by implementing robust JWT authentication, fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC), input sanitization schemas, and AES-256 data encryption for sensitive customer records.
AWS Cloud Infrastructure Scaling: Assisted infrastructure migration and provisioning on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), scaling concurrent tracking capacity by ~50%.
